Author: OOFGames
Name: Mini Games Emporium
Punchline: Five live games under one roof, with more on the way.
Description: The all-in-one hosting tool for FFXIV gambling venues, with five live games: BAR 777, Deathroll Tournament, Higher/Lower, Raffle, and Voting Madness. Handles player queues, trade verification, boosted pots, ticket draws, live vote tallying, automated chat, and a full transaction ledger.
Changelog:
- New game Voting Madness! - Use this for when you want to vote on something within a venue and it will catch all votes for you! See more details in announcements.
- UI overhaul for the sidebar to match other plugins.
- You can now add eliminated players back into the game for Deathroll Tournament.
- Minor fixes for DRT messages.
- Credits added for Habitat and 1-UP on game suggestions.
